method: desk research only: arXiv API and abs/html pages of v1-v3 (figure SVGs fetched and bar heights read from their geometry), GitHub API via gh (repository, commits, git tree at the pin, README, LICENSE, ACCESS.md, experiment and harness code at the pin), PyPI JSON for inspect-ai release dates, inspect_ai issue search, Zenodo/HF search; our own reports (phase-10f census/trial, regen-batch items 16/25/28, D-150..D-156, D-372, D-374, core review D CD-24/CD-25). papers.title: Why Do Language Model Agents Whistleblow? (Agrawal, Xiao, Bergman, Cooper Stickland)
papers.relation: describes the corpus: WhistleBench dataset, experiments and the final_runs logs (Appendix A.9 points to final_runs/ in the repository)
papers.versions: v1 2025-11-21 (251 KB), v2 2025-12-27 (242 KB), v3 2026-04-23 (247 KB); CC BY 4.0. v1->v2: one author affiliation changed, a punctuation edit, one sentence added in 3.2 saying the task prompts are hand-crafted and not representative of any company; v2->v3: no text change besides the date stamp and a stray figure back-reference. All 15 figure SVGs are byte-identical in v1, v2 and v3 (fetched from arxiv.org/html/2511.17085v1..v3), so no reported number changed between versions. Results are given only as bar charts (no numeric tables). https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17085v1

History: 71688cd9683e 2025-11-18 'Initial public release' (300 files, every log and all code in one squashed commit); 87b4385963ae 2025-11-21 README canary strings (+9 lines); 39a2bbd9cf0d and 9c27637c3cf6 2025-11-27 README paper link (1 line each). No commit after the first touches final_runs/ or the harness code. Git tree at the pin (GitHub git-trees API, not truncated): final_runs/ = 223 blobs, 523,183,391 bytes = profile expected_files/bytes; 184 .eval (522,052,717 B, 1,420,537..4,717,315 B each, 184 distinct blob SHAs); 39 context files (19 analysis/aggregated_analysis .csv, 9 logs.json, 2 eval-set.json, 9 .eval-set-id; all_models has no logs.json or .eval-set-id). Experiment scripts at the pin (highagency/whistlebench/experiments/*.py, eval.py, tasks.py, scorers.py, types.py) define the arms: https://github.com/legobridge/whistlebench/blob/9c27637c3cf6dfb2c0d5801c7f3d91358cb587bc/highagency/whistlebench/experiments/all_models.py. There is no script for 0_baseline_gpt_4.1_grader or for awareness_blackbox. The pinned scorer function is named 'whistleblowing' while the logs' score key (phase-10f census) is 'email_whistleblowing', so the code that produced the logs is not exactly the published code (history squashed). README claims: 'Complete Results: Full experimental data and model transcripts'; its storyline summaries (food safety Salmonella, medical devices surgical robots, mining water contamination) disagree with the paper's Table 1 and with the pinned data file names (Cronobacter, infusion-pump time-sync drift, tailings dam). README and types.py list a 'translation' responsibility and a 'pharma' storyline that the paper does not report. README: https://github.com/legobridge/whistlebench/blob/9c27637c3cf6dfb2c0d5801c7f3d91358cb587bc/README.md [CORRECTED by fact-check] 'No script for awareness_blackbox': there is no eval-set driver, but the SnitchBench task (high_agency_deliberation_awareness) is defined at the pin in highagency/snitchbench/tasks.py; habench_summarization uses high_agency with include_evaluation_deliberation (no driver).
data_record: No Zenodo, Hugging Face or Figshare record (Zenodo API q=whistlebench: 0 hits; HF datasets search 'whistlebench': 0; GitHub repository search: only legobridge/whistlebench). The data record is the git tree final_runs/ at the pin; it matches the profile pin exactly (223 files, 523,183,391 B; 184 .eval, 522,052,717 B = census bytes). Git blob SHA-1s from the trees API are the only upstream checksums; our census holds sha256 per .eval (docs/reports/phase10f/whistlebench.census.json). https://api.github.com/repos/legobridge/whistlebench/git/trees/9c27637c3cf6dfb2c0d5801c7f3d91358cb587bc?recursive=1
harness: Inspect AI (UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai): 0.3.130 (PyPI 2025-09-07; 161 logs / 8,050 samples) and 0.3.134.dev31+geb46eef8 (commit eb46eef8 2025-09-25, 31 commits after 0.3.133; 23 logs / 1,150 samples, all in awareness_blackbox), log format version 2 (census). Agent: react(name='Agent', submit=AgentSubmit(name='Submit')), message_limit=30, eval_set with reasoning_effort=medium, reasoning_tokens=1536, reasoning_summary=detailed, epochs=50, retry_on_error=10, retry_attempts=10 (eval.py, tasks.py at the pin). Judge: grader_model default openai/gpt-5 with reasoning_effort=minimal; the whistleblowing judge is called only when an email was sent or a file written outside /Users/<scenario-user>/ or the scratchpad (pinned scorers.py). Known producer behaviours at these versions (our own analyses): ToolEvent.message_id names the first result message of a parallel batch (introduced with the field in 0.3.113, PR https://github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai/pull/2100 merged 2025-07-05; fixed by 0.3.263), react's _remove_submit_tool removes the submit result message, model_copy message copies share call ids (regeneration-batch item 16, D-155 addenda); ScoreEvent has no 'scorer' field before 0.3.217 (CD-24); timestamps carry local offsets (-05:00, -04:00, -07:00; naive datetimes forbidden only from 0.3.151) (CD-25); model API call bodies kept for the first 5 calls per model per sample when log_model_api is unset (D-374 U6-b). No upstream issue reports the message_id batch defect (GitHub search on 2026-10-14). [CORRECTED by fact-check 2026-10-14] The react/Submit/message_limit=30/epochs 50/retry_on_error=10/reasoning medium/grader openai/gpt-5 settings are those of task high_agency (176 logs; whistlebench/eval.py and tasks.py). The 8 SnitchBench logs come from task high_agency_deliberation_awareness in highagency/snitchbench/tasks.py at the pin: message_limit=15, AgentSubmit without a name (Inspect default 'submit'), tools write_logs + send_email, default grader_model openai/gpt-4.1, scorers gov/media/internal_snitching + deliberation_analysis; no driver at the pin calls it, so its epochs, reasoning effort and grader are not documented by code. https://github.com/legobridge/whistlebench/blob/9c27637c3cf6dfb2c0d5801c7f3d91358cb587bc/highagency/snitchbench/tasks.py
